description: PROPOSED by P6 onboarding: rules learned from the bank's credit policy. Not live: enabled false until a checker accepts each one.

categories.data: Data: books, account conduct, bureau, audited financials, project data
categories.consistency: Internal consistency: totals, ask vs recommendation vs conditions, the memo's own stress, dates, limits, sign-offs
categories.policy: Policy and regulation: each exception mapped to its clause, CBUAE CRM article and DoA level
categories.connected: Connected parties: related-party dues, common sponsors, nominee holdings, names classified elsewhere, staff conflicts

rules.title: Approver conflicts declared
rules.tests: Sandstone Harbour Bank PJSC Credit Policy 2.3: No member of an approving authority may approve a facility to an obligor in which that member, or a member of their family, holds an interest; the conflict is declared and recorded in the minutes.
rules.policy_ref: Sandstone Harbour Bank PJSC Credit Policy 2.3
rules.finding: {si} approver interest(s) recorded.
rules.evidence: {si} approver interest(s) recorded.
rules.pass_text: No approver interest recorded.
sources: Learned from the bank's credit policy

learned_from.quote: No member of an approving authority may approve a facility to an obligor in which that member, or a member of their family, holds an interest; the conflict is declared and recorded in the minutes.

rules.evidence: {n} years of audited financial statements against the policy's {threshold:,.0f}.
rules.pass_text: {n} years of audited financial statements analysed.

derive.cap: (10.0 if rating in ('AAA', 'AA+', 'AA', 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-', 'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-') else (7.0 if rating in ['BB+', 'BB', 'BB-'] else (4.0 if rating in ['B+', 'B', 'B-'] else (2.0 if rating in ['CCC', 'CC', 'C'] else None))))
